TC-14/S41.title: A dictated number never becomes a diagnosis label (BP 124/78, A1c 6.1, K 5.2, BMI 31, HR 104, temp 38.1)
TC-14/S41.detail: Dev <dev address> (main 8b4be94a), live models (every call Haiku 4.5 us.anthropic.claude-haiku-4-5-20251001-v1:0, no fallback; generateNote providerMs 7.1–15.1 s, parsePreRoundNotes 4.5–5.3 s), under runs/.dev.lock, browsers in UTC; datasets hallu-hosp + hallu-nh (new specs hallu-hosp/-nh.spec.ts + hallu-lib.ts), 10 synthetic fixtures (5 Hospital, 5 Nursing Home) × arm A (pre-round Save Note → summary → Encounter → Generate) and arm B (same words in the Encounter only → Generate); only prefixed rows created, all deleted (0 remaining, 0 changes to other rows). Trap verdicts by the fixture regexes, 13 'unclear'/false hits settled by the agent's reading (review.agent.json, a person confirms). Preston-kit judge (grade.mjs, claude-opus-5-5 ×2) on all 20 notes: 20/20 uncalibrated FAIL (U1 on every note, U2 on 16), beside, needs a person. Arm A 2/8 invented: HL-H5 'BMI 31' → summary '• Obesity — BMI 31' → note '…and obesity' (the BMI value itself is gone from the note); HL-N3 'BP 124/78' (+ lisinopril) → note '1. Hypertension — Blood pressure 124/78 mmHg on lisinopril 10 daily. Well controlled.' (not in the summary; arm B writes the same). Summary only: HL-H3 'Potassium 5.2' → course 'hyperkalemia at 5.2' (both notes say 'potassium is elevated at 5.2', recorded). Arm B 1/8 (HL-N3). A1c 6.1, HR 104, temp 38.1, Hospital BP 124/78: as dictated.

stated.quote: No diagnosis, medication decision, or action appears in the note unless it was dictated or typed
